requirement_groups.assertion: Typed local fixture evidence, exact revision/passage/application provenance, contradiction visibility, and clean/reuse separation.
One bounded analyzer over three factual members preserves admitted, negative, and ambiguous states without output labels in product input.
Typed consequence/cause/recommendation facts derive one supported and one lead-only path with one labeled coverage population and no safety claim.
Immutable bindings, targeted recomputation, retained replay, equivalent output, explicit gaps, and external boundaries not-used.

adr_groups.assertion: Bounded evidence, analysis, immutable binding, publication, and replay rules exercised by the four cases.
Typed taxonomy/evidence-state separation and partial publication exercised only for the declared synthetic facts.
Public continuation claim boundary; no private verdict or protocol work.

eval_entries.assertion: Snapshot/context/config/input bindings remain immutable across clean, incremental, changed-source, and replay requests.
Three delivered members derive one admitted, one resolved-negative, and one ambiguous decision with exact candidate/hypothesis/abstention counts.
One lead-only path is separately counted and has zero readiness effect.
Clean, unchanged incremental, formatting-only source revision, and retained replay remain distinct; no refresh transport is used.
Local fixture revision, passage, claim application, supplying snapshot, and consuming context are traversable.
Retained replay produces semantically equivalent human and JSON views with visible gaps.
All four requests are network-off with provider, search, Nexus, and LOOT explicitly not-used.
Claims, candidate decisions, hypotheses, findings, recommendations, leads, and gaps remain typed and model-free.
The local source-to-conclusion dependency chain and contradiction are explicit; external nodes are not-used.
Neutral causal facts derive one single-member supported group and one separate lead-only path.
One three-member population reports denominator, completed count, state, and visible gap without a combined safety percentage.
Declared purpose and consequence remain separate typed axes for the supplied generic subject.
Retained replay verifies exact dependency identity and preserves append-only history.
